13.2.6.3 EcuM Flex Use Case: use Alarm Clock
Scenario: a Basic Software Module wants to use an alarm clock. In this case the following rules apply:
[TPS_BSWMDT_04137] Basic Software Module wants to use an alarm clock (flexible variant) ⌈ RoleBasedBswModuleEntryAssignment valid roles:
• EcuM_SetRelWakeupAlarm [1]
• EcuM_SetAbsWakeupAlarm [1]
• EcuM_AbortWakeupAlarm [1]
• EcuM_SetClock [1] RoleBasedDataAssignment N/A RoleBasedDataTypeAssignment N/A
⌋()
